screen.fpstune.title: FPS Tune Settings
screen.fpstune.description: Optional local render controls. Changes are saved only when you press Done.
option.fpstune.enabled.tooltip: Master switch. FPS Tune is disabled by default and changes only local rendering.
option.fpstune.particle_admission.toolti: Limit particles admitted to the client particle engine when FPS Tune is enabled.
option.fpstune.weather_rendering.tooltip: Keep vanilla weather rendering enabled while FPS Tune is enabled.
option.fpstune.max_particles.tooltip: Maximum particles admitted per client tick when particle limiting is enabled.
